system.description:
Bruises, blood patterns and the position of a corpse tell you a story long after the victim has stopped speaking.
When using Examine the Dead, reduce the required time from 10 minutes to 1 minute.
In addition, when you achieve at least a Success on Examine the Dead, you gain a +1-circumstance bonus to subsequent Perception, Medicine, Survival or appropriate knowledge checks made to investigate the circumstances of that death.

Prerequisites Medicine 3 ranks

Works automatically: +1 circumstance is offered on Perception, Medicine and Survival checks with the book's wording; Examine the Dead in 1 minute is a note.

conditionals.label: Death Investigator
conditionals.scope: Investigating the circumstances of a death after a successful Examine the Dead
